verdict: Organic traffic is holding; paid channels are off and being addressed.
narrative: This period, all activity came through your Google Business Profile and organic site traffic — paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend and generated zero leads over the full 28 days. Your Google Business Profile delivered 43 actions (1 call, 22 direction requests, 20 website clicks), though profile actions dipped 37.5% in the most recent 7 days compared to the prior 7, likely reflecting a seasonal softening in local search demand. Website traffic held up well, with 191 sessions and a slight week-over-week gain, which suggests your organic presence remains intact. Conversion tracking on the website is being repaired, so the zero conversions shown this period under-reports actual contact activity. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority so you have a second, controllable source of leads alongside organic.
